source_url_or_tool: sharp metadata and file sizes for images referenced by content
scope: Resize oversized post hero images served without the Next image optimizer

observations.summary: next.config sets images.unoptimized, so files in public/images are sent to visitors as stored. Six referenced images were 318 to 955 KB at 1500 to 1600 px wide.
observations.inference_limit: File size only; no field Core Web Vitals data collected.

observations.summary: Re-encoded in place at 1200 px wide, WebP quality 72: img-2109 955->437 KB, img-1011 726->328 KB, img-0073 587->253 KB, img-0503 505->202 KB, img-1206 389->157 KB, img-1669 318->134 KB. Total 3.48 MB to 1.51 MB. Same paths and aspect ratios, so no content or URL change.
observations.inference_limit: Visual quality checked by spot inspection.
